inviter_text: If you are an active Harbor Workshop subscriber and not a contractor, invite one person who has never subscribed. If they start a subscription and complete a $7 first payment by 30 November and it settles, you receive a two-hour studio credit in your account within seven days. Start your subscription by 30 November.
recipient_text: An active Harbor Workshop subscriber may invite you if you have never subscribed. Start a subscription and complete the $7 first payment by 30 November. No recipient reward is offered. Start your subscription by 30 November.
short_disclosure: For an active, non-contractor subscriber inviting one never-subscribed person: the recipient must start a subscription and complete a $7 first payment by 30 November; after payment settles, the inviter receives a two-hour studio credit in their account within seven days. The recipient receives no reward.
ineligible_case_response: A person who is not an active Harbor Workshop subscriber or is a contractor cannot be the inviter. A recipient who has subscribed before does not meet the supplied recipient condition.

fact_trace.draft_claim: Inviter must be active and not a contractor.
$7 first payment must be completed by 30 November and settle.
Inviter receives two-hour studio credit in account within seven days.

assumptions_or_conflicts.issue: No supplied conflict or missing material term identified.

scope_boundary: This kit supplies copy guidance only; it neither determines a named person's eligibility nor enrolls anyone, and it does not authorize the program, send invitations, process payments, or issue or deliver rewards.
